title: Inside $85M James Bond mansion 'Villa Skyfall' in Florida
summary_full: Villa Skyfall, a stunning estate available for $85 million in Delray Beach, Florida, epitomizes luxury living. This mansion presents an entire ecosystem tailored for its affluent owner, including equipped closets and a fully functioning kitchen. Its design channels a James Bond aesthetic, prioritizing security and privacy. Stone Creek Ranch is becoming a magnet for global elite, enhanced by the allure of Florida's lack of a state income tax.
